# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

### Kaufmännische Entscheider

Alles aus einer Hand - Richard Wolf liefert als Komplettanbieter für die Endoskopie ein
zukunftsfähiges Spektrum innovativer Instrumente und Systemlösungen für minimal-invasive Eingriffe.
Alle Instrumente werden in enger Kooperation mit Wissenschaftlern und Medizinern entwickelt, sind
bestens aufeinander abgestimmt und für mehrere Fachdisziplinen geeignet. Die hohe
Verarbeitungsqualität sorgt für besondere Langlebigkeit im OP-Einsatz und trägt zu einem Höchstmaß
an Investitionssicherheit bei. Mit unseren individuellen Finanzierungskonzepten bleiben Sie flexibel
und umgehen Investitionsstaus. Informieren Sie sich jetzt über unsere speziellen Services.

[Alles rund um Service & Beratung][59]

### Ärzte

Wir setzen nicht nur in bewährten Techniken neue Standards, sondern folgen aktuellen Trends in der
Medizin und entwickeln daraus innovative Instrumente und Systemlösungen für viele Fachdisziplinen.
Alle Instrumente sind optimal aufeinander abgestimmt, ergonomisch gestaltet und intuitiv bedienbar.
Diese Benutzerfreundlichkeit trägt zu optimalen Ergebnissen bei und erleichtert die Arbeit im OP.
Überzeugen Sie sich von unseren Produkten für Ihre Disziplin oder erfahren Sie mehr über unsere
fachübergreifenden Lösungen.

[Unsere Disziplinen][60]     [Unsere Lösungen][61]     [Unsere Hospitationen][62]

 

### OP-Funktionspersonal

Alle Instrumente und Systemlösungen von Richard Wolf zeichnen sich durch eine einfache Bedienbarkeit
aus. Garantierte Qualität und hervorragende Handhabbarkeit tragen wesentlich zum reibungslosen
Ablauf von Operationen bei. Unsere Instrumente lassen sich sehr einfach montieren und demontieren.
Ebenso erlauben sie die individuelle Zusammenstellung für alle Ansprüche und Anwendungen, enthalten
untereinander kompatible Komponenten und sind vielfältig einsetzbar. Die optimal aufeinander
abgestimmten Instrumente vereinfachen durch ihre intuitive Benutzerführung die Einarbeitung und
ihren Einsatz im Operationssaal. Überzeugen Sie sich von unseren fachübergreifenden Lösungen oder
erfahren Sie, welches Instrumentarium Richard Wolf für Ihre Disziplin bietet.

[Unsere Disziplinen][63]     [Unsere Lösungen][64]

Ablauf von Operationen bei. Unsere Instrumente lassen sich sehr einfach montieren und demontieren.

ihren Einsatz im Operationssaal. Überzeugen Sie sich von unseren fachübergreifenden Lösungen oder
erfahren Sie, welches Instrumentarium Richard Wolf für Ihre Disziplin bietet.

lassen und ohne besondere** **Wartungsmaßnahmen auskommen. Neben der Langlebigkeit zeichnen sich die

# BCAN: Empowering Better Todays & More Tomorrows

### We advocate for better todays and more tomorrows for everyone impacted by bladder cancer by
### focusing on four critical areas: education, support, research and policy.

[Find Help Now][128]

## Understanding Bladder Cancer

### What is bladder cancer?

Bladder cancer most often begins in the urothelial cells that line the inside of your bladder.
Cancer occurs when cells in the bladder start to grow out of control. Most tumors develop on the
inner layer of the bladder. Some can grow into deeper bladder layers. As cancer grows through these
layers into the muscle wall, it becomes harder to treat.

[Newly Diagnosed? Start Here!][129]
Dr. Armine Smith

## Signs & Symptoms

### Learn the signs and symptoms of bladder cancer!
* Blood in urine (hematuria)
* Painful urination
* Urgent need to urinate
* Frequent urination
* Feeling the need (but unable) to pass urine

[Learn More About Bladder Cancer][130]

## Get Involved

### Why Bladder Cancer Support Matters
* An estimated ****84,530**** people will be diagnosed with bladder cancer in the U.S. in 2026.
* About 9 out of 10 people with this cancer are **over the age of 55**.
* Bladder cancer is the** 4th most common cancer in men**.
* **1 out of 4 bladder cancer patients are women**—and they have worse outcomes at every stage of
  the disease than men.

tomorrow.

# BCAN: Empowering Better Todays & More Tomorrows

### We advocate for better todays and more tomorrows for everyone impacted by bladder cancer by
### focusing on four critical areas: education, support, research and policy.

[Find Help Now][128]

## Understanding Bladder Cancer

### What is bladder cancer?

Bladder cancer most often begins in the urothelial cells that line the inside of your bladder.
Cancer occurs when cells in the bladder start to grow out of control. Most tumors develop on the
inner layer of the bladder. Some can grow into deeper bladder layers. As cancer grows through these
layers into the muscle wall, it becomes harder to treat.

[Newly Diagnosed? Start Here!][129]
Dr. Armine Smith

## Signs & Symptoms

### Learn the signs and symptoms of bladder cancer!
* Blood in urine (hematuria)
* Painful urination
* Urgent need to urinate
* Frequent urination
* Feeling the need (but unable) to pass urine

[Learn More About Bladder Cancer][130]

## Get Involved

### Why Bladder Cancer Support Matters
* An estimated ****84,530**** people will be diagnosed with bladder cancer in the U.S. in 2026.
* About 9 out of 10 people with this cancer are **over the age of 55**.
* Bladder cancer is the** 4th most common cancer in men**.
* **1 out of 4 bladder cancer patients are women**—and they have worse outcomes at every stage of
  the disease than men.

### A Community For People Impacted By Bladder Cancer

Have you been impacted by bladder cancer? We’re here to help. The Bladder Cancer Advocacy Network
(BCAN) provides patients with the critical information and community support they need to thrive
today – and champions innovative research and responsive national policy to inspire hope for
tomorrow.

and refusing to give up.

THE OBJECTIVE LENS IN CYSTOSCOPY

# Transforming bladder cancer care.

Cystotech is on a mission to support clinicians during cystoscopy and contribute to improved care
and quality of life for bladder cancer patients. We are deeply committed to developing technology
grounded in the realities of everyday practice – prioritizing usability, seamless workflow
integration, and meaningful clinical value.

CLINICAL WORKFLOW ENHANCEMENT · REAL-TIME SUPPORT · CLINICIAN REMAINS THE DECISION-MAKER

[Connect with us ][7][See our solution ][8]
[Screenshot 2026-05-08 at 12.09.13.png]

# 25%

False positive rate in routine diagnostic cystoscopy – leading to overtreatment.

[Source][9]

THE PROBLEM

##### White-light cystoscopy remains the standard of care, but bladder cancer is difficult to
##### consistently identify during visual assessment.

# 35%

Of bladder tumors are overlooked during first-line detection.

[Source][10]

# $12B

Annual cost of bladder cancer care across the EU and US.

[US reference][11]

[EU reference][12]

HOW CYSTOAID® WORKS

## What the human eye can’t see, CystoAID® reveals.

03 · CLINICIAN-LED

###### Developed by clinicians

CystoAID® was created from real clinical insight gained through more than a decade of hands-on
experience. Designed around the practical challenges of everyday cystoscopy, the product is built to
support clinicians in real-world practice.


[Cystotech-team-Large.jpg]

02 · INTEGRATED

###### Built for clinical reality

CystoAID® is device-agnostic, plug-and-play, and on-premise – integrating seamlessly with existing
3G-SDI cystoscopy systems without cloud dependency or workflow disruption.




[Screenshot 2026-04-23 at 13.49.03.png]

01 · OBJECTIVE

###### From subjective to objective

Cystoscopy today relies on real-time visual interpretation, where subtle abnormalities may be
difficult to identify and characterize in real time.

CystoAID® provides AI-assisted decision support to support clinician evaluation of suspicious
urothelial lesions during cystoscopy.

[Cystotech.png]
[Our solution ][13]

VALUE ADD

## Where CystoAID® adds clinical value.

[2.png]

SCENARIO 01

###### Initial diagnostic cystoscopy

Problem: Visually suspicious findings may be difficult to identify during initial cystoscopy,
potentially delaying diagnosis and treatment planning – impacting outcomes and increasing downstream
costs.

 

Value add: CystoAID® aims to reduce the risk of overlooked tumors, enabling earlier detection and
more effective treatment pathways.

[12.png]

SCENARIO 02

###### Surveillance cystoscopy

Problem: The risk of bladder cancer recurrence requires long-term surveillance, with cystoscopy
typically repeated at risk-adapted intervals from every 3 months to annually.


Value add: CystoAID® supports consistent, objective detection across surveillance procedures, aiming
to reduce the risk of missed recurrence and the burden of late-stage re-treatment.

[6.png]

SCENARIO 03

###### TURBT and intraoperative use

Problem: Incomplete resection is a recognized contributor to early recurrence in non-muscle-invasive
bladder cancer.


Value add: CystoAID® supports real-time visual confirmation during tumour removal, aiming to improve
resection completeness. The goal is to reduce the need for re-TURBT, lower readmission rates, and
decrease overall procedural costs.

[3.png]

SCENARIO 04

###### Meeting growing demand

Problem: Bladder cancer is a significant and growing global health burden. With increasing demand
for urologic evaluation and ongoing pressure on specialist capacity, clinicians need tools that can
support efficient, high-quality cystoscopy workflows.


Value add: CystoAID® supports consistent decision-making across procedures, helping maintain quality
under increasing clinical pressure and a growing caseload.

[Untitled-design-7.png]

###### “ Missed lesions during cystoscopy remain one of the most consequential and underappreciated
###### challenges in bladder cancer care. Real-time AI-assisted detection represents a meaningful
###### step toward closing that gap and ultimately improving outcomes for our patients.
######  

Ashish M. Kamat, MD · Professor of Urology

PRESIDENT INTERNATIONAL BLADDER GROUP

EVIDENCE

## The evidence speaks for itself.

CystoAID® has been validated across 71 real-world procedures and 437,244 video frames (RAISE01).

 

Subsequently, clinical performance and safety were confirmed in a randomized controlled
non-inferiority trial in 64 patients (RAIS02).

[Read the RAISE01 study ][14][Read the RAISE02 study ][15]

→ RAISE03 – Enrollment H2 2026

# 96.2%

Sensitivity in randomized controlled trial.

Non-inferiority design.

# 88.1%

Positive Predictive Value. Fewer false positives

Results from RAISE01

2024 published  study

2025 published  study

integration, and meaningful clinical value.

HOW CYSTOAID® WORKS

## What the human eye can’t see, CystoAID® reveals.

03 · CLINICIAN-LED

###### Developed by clinicians

CystoAID® was created from real clinical insight gained through more than a decade of hands-on
experience. Designed around the practical challenges of everyday cystoscopy, the product is built to
support clinicians in real-world practice.


[Cystotech-team-Large.jpg]

02 · INTEGRATED

###### Built for clinical reality

CystoAID® is device-agnostic, plug-and-play, and on-premise – integrating seamlessly with existing
3G-SDI cystoscopy systems without cloud dependency or workflow disruption.




[Screenshot 2026-04-23 at 13.49.03.png]

01 · OBJECTIVE

###### From subjective to objective

Cystoscopy today relies on real-time visual interpretation, where subtle abnormalities may be
difficult to identify and characterize in real time.

CystoAID® provides AI-assisted decision support to support clinician evaluation of suspicious
urothelial lesions during cystoscopy.

[Cystotech.png]

VALUE ADD

## Where CystoAID® adds clinical value.

[2.png]

SCENARIO 01

###### Initial diagnostic cystoscopy

Problem: Visually suspicious findings may be difficult to identify during initial cystoscopy,
potentially delaying diagnosis and treatment planning – impacting outcomes and increasing downstream
costs.

 

Value add: CystoAID® aims to reduce the risk of overlooked tumors, enabling earlier detection and
more effective treatment pathways.

[12.png]

SCENARIO 02

###### Surveillance cystoscopy

Problem: The risk of bladder cancer recurrence requires long-term surveillance, with cystoscopy
typically repeated at risk-adapted intervals from every 3 months to annually.


Value add: CystoAID® supports consistent, objective detection across surveillance procedures, aiming
to reduce the risk of missed recurrence and the burden of late-stage re-treatment.

[6.png]

SCENARIO 03

###### TURBT and intraoperative use

Problem: Incomplete resection is a recognized contributor to early recurrence in non-muscle-invasive
bladder cancer.


Value add: CystoAID® supports real-time visual confirmation during tumour removal, aiming to improve
resection completeness. The goal is to reduce the need for re-TURBT, lower readmission rates, and
decrease overall procedural costs.

[3.png]

SCENARIO 04

###### Meeting growing demand

Problem: Bladder cancer is a significant and growing global health burden. With increasing demand
for urologic evaluation and ongoing pressure on specialist capacity, clinicians need tools that can
support efficient, high-quality cystoscopy workflows.


Value add: CystoAID® supports consistent decision-making across procedures, helping maintain quality
under increasing clinical pressure and a growing caseload.

[Untitled-design-7.png]

# See bladder cancer in a different light

Blue Light Cystoscopy with Cysview® improves detection of non-muscle invasive bladder cancer^{1,2}

[ Find out more ][31]

## What is Cysview?

FDA-approved Cysview makes [non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) ][32]tumors glow bright pink
under blue light during Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®).^{3}

Cysview solution is placed into the bladder of a bladder cancer patient via a catheter one hour
prior to BLC.^{3} During BLC, Cysview then allows urologists to remove cancer more completely than
with standard White Light Cystoscopy (WLC) alone, because BLC with Cysview makes tumors more
visible.^{1,2
}

Cysview is an optical imaging agent indicated for the cystoscopic detection of carcinoma of the
bladder, including carcinoma in situ (CIS), in adult patients:
* with suspected or known lesion(s) on the basis of a prior cystoscopy
* undergoing surveillance cystoscopy for bladder cancer.

[ Find out if Cysview is suitable for you ][33]

## Who is Cysview® for?

Cysview is for use in people suspected of having, or are known to have, bladder cancer or those
undergoing bladder cancer surveillance.^{3}

It should be used during initial or repeat [transurethral resection of bladder tumor][34] (TURBT)^{4
}and in surveillance cystoscopies.^{5}

[ Could Cysview be for me? ][35]
[ Where is Cysview available? ][36]

Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®) with Cysview® improves [non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)][37]
tumor detection^{1,2}

Two different prospective, multicenter clinical studies looked into the effectiveness of BLC with
Cysview versus standard White Light Cystoscopy (WLC) alone in detecting bladder cancer in over 300
patients with known or suspected bladder cancer.

They showed that BLC with Cysview improved tumor detection during surgery and in follow-ups:^{1–3}

## Could Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®) with Cysview® be for me?

BLC with Cysview should be considered for patients that are:

At initial [transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TURBT][41]) on suspicion of [non-muscle
invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)][42]^{4}
* Having repeat TURBT^{4}

Being checked to assess response to [Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)][43] therapy six weeks after
completion^{4}
* Undergoing surveillance^{4,5}
* Prior to intravesical therapy when residual disease is suspected, i.e., patient has not previously
  had BLC with Cysview^{5}
* With positive cytology and negative White Light Cystoscopy (WLC)^{4}

Cysview may not detect all bladder tumors and is not a replacement for random biopsies

## Two types of cystoscopy

White Light Cystoscopy (WLC)

In a standard cystoscopy procedure, the light used is a regular white light – the type used to light
a room. White light helps the urologist visually assess the general health of the bladder and find
easily visible irregularities to be further evaluated.^{6}

Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®)

When blue light technology and Cysview are available, they are used together with white light in the
BLC procedure. The urologist first views the bladder with white light, then switches to blue light
to see any bright pink tumor tissue areas that Cysview has caused to fluoresce.^{6} The urologist
then switches between white and blue light to perform the necessary tumor removal.^{6}

## Could Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®) with Cysview® be for me?

BLC with Cysview should be considered for patients that are:

At initial [transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TURBT][41]) on suspicion of [non-muscle
invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)][42]^{4}
* Having repeat TURBT^{4}

Being checked to assess response to [Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)][43] therapy six weeks after
completion^{4}
* Undergoing surveillance^{4,5}
* Prior to intravesical therapy when residual disease is suspected, i.e., patient has not previously
  had BLC with Cysview^{5}
* With positive cytology and negative White Light Cystoscopy (WLC)^{4}

Cysview may not detect all bladder tumors and is not a replacement for random biopsies

## Two types of cystoscopy

White Light Cystoscopy (WLC)

In a standard cystoscopy procedure, the light used is a regular white light – the type used to light
a room. White light helps the urologist visually assess the general health of the bladder and find
easily visible irregularities to be further evaluated.^{6}

Blue Light Cystoscopy (BLC®)

When blue light technology and Cysview are available, they are used together with white light in the
BLC procedure. The urologist first views the bladder with white light, then switches to blue light
to see any bright pink tumor tissue areas that Cysview has caused to fluoresce.^{6} The urologist
then switches between white and blue light to perform the necessary tumor removal.^{6}

## [EFSA lowers safe level for exposure to TFA ][200]

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has reduced the safe level of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA)
in the diet based on new scientific evidence. TFA is a breakdown product of some pesticides.

new level of maturity.

EMDDA operates as a professional alliance facilitating meetings and partnerships in the European
medical device market

Identification of innovative medical devices and relevant market opportunities across Europe.

### Connect the network

Connection between medical device manufacturers and selected EU distributors.

### Build partnerships

Support of long-term commercial partnerships in local European markets.

Strategies for increasing product visibility across diverse European markets.

Urological conditions have ailed mankind since the dawning of time. Circumcision and attempts to
treat urinary stones are among the earliest surgical procedures. Urology as a medical specialisation
has developed over the last two centuries.

The European Association of Urology, through its History Office has been tracing and documenting the
origins of our field.

The museum has two main roles. First, telling the story of urology (in Europe) through the section
**[History of Urology][17]**, highlighting some of the main protagonists in this story
through **[Biographies][18].** This is a work in progress, and by no means an exhaustive overview!

Second, the museum aims brings together the many disparate collections of urological instruments and
artefacts that are in possession of the EAU History Office, its members and other collections. The
[**Collections**][19] section of the Museum is an extensive database of these items.
The [**Blog**][20] showcases individual items from the collections and tells the often personal
story behind the items.

The EAU European Museum of Urology embodies a long-held wish: a museum that brings together the
collections of urological instruments around Europe, and tells the visitor the story of urology.
Join us for a journey into the past!

# Supporting Medical Device and IVD Manufacturers in Expanding to New Markets Worldwide 


Enter Global Healthcare Markets with Confidence

Home: Text
[Mask Group 1.png]

#### Expert Guidance for strategic Medical Equipment Distribution

Expanding into new international healthcare markets can be challenging. Whether you need to identify
and manage a medical equipment distributor in Brazil or China, register your medical devices in KSA
or India, or determine the best ASEAN or European markets to enter, Luctor Medical is here to help.
Our expertise spans across global medical device trade, regulatory compliance for medical devices,
and international healthcare solutions.

 

With a team of experienced professionals across [North and South America][19], [Asia Pacific][20],
[Europe][21], [Middle East and Africa,][22] we support your market entry strategy, from selecting
high-quality medical equipment distributors worldwide to ensuring seamless regulatory approvals. Our
mission is to make your healthcare market entry smooth and successful.


## How Luctor Medical Supports Your Market Entry

#### Comprehensive Solutions for International Medical Trade

### International Market Prioritization

We help your company identify and shortlist priority markets, ensuring you focus on the most
promising opportunities for medical technology exports.

[Learn More][23]

### Market Assessment and Go-to-Market Strategy

Understanding the complexities of global healthcare markets is crucial. We provide thorough market
research, giving you the intelligence needed to define a winning go-to-market strategy for your
medical devices and IVD.

[Learn More][24]

### Finding and Selecting Medical Device & IVD Distributors

Luctor Medical assists in researching, analyzing, and selecting the right distributors for your
products, ensuring successful medical product distribution channels worldwide.

[Learn More][25]

### Distributor Management

If your resources are limited or the market presents challenges, we manage your medical equipment
distributors on your behalf to ensure optimal performance.

[Learn More][26]

### Market Access and Regulatory Support

Regulatory compliance for medical devices and IVDs is essential in any healthcare market. We help
you navigate local requirements and offer in-country representation.

[Learn More][27]

### Healthcare Market Research & Intelligence

We provide data-driven insights to support your strategic market entry, offering a solid foundation
for decision making in expanding healthcare markets.

[Learn More][28]

### Why Partner with Luctor Medical?

[check2-circle.png]

100% Dedication to the Medical Device and IVD Industry
In-Depth Knowledge of Local Markets, Customs, and Business Culture
Multilingual Capabilities for Seamless Communication
Extensive Experience in International Business Development
Access to Multi-Disciplinary Experts (Regulatory, Legal, Logistics, etc.)
Strong International Partnerships in Medical Technology

[Request a Proposal or Ask a Question][29]

## About Us

Mars Medical, located in Europe’s #1 Innovative region and Mecca of Medical Device development, the
state of Baden-Württemberg, provides consultation as a European Authorised Representative for your
medical devices. We offer various levels of support for your device representation in EU region as a
E.A.R.
We have extensively worked in new device/ technology development in the area of gynecology, urology,
cardiology, neurology. We also worked in development of surgical instruments/ implants for Cosmetic
surgery, robotic surgery with a focus on Minimal Invasive interventions. This makes us unique as
your E.A.R. as we could able to provide excellent guidance for your products success in EEA region.

Home: Services

## Services


We offer E.A.R. services to suit your exact need. You can decide about the desired level of
representation that you require. Final agreement of role and responsibilities can be mutually
decided after thorough discussion about your device and your future plans.Contact us for further
details.With any of our existing E.A.R. services viz. Standard, Advanced or Advanced Plus, we offer
special offers for every additional products from the same family.We can also help you in setting up
QMS from our well established partners. Please write to
us your requirements by directly mailing us at [info@marsmedical.de][9] or by filling form through
Contact Us section.

Learn More
[Business Meeting]

### Standard

Your device is already CE marked. Your device is well registered with local competitive authority/
authorities and placed on the market in EU region. This means that you already have appointed E.A.R.
However, you want to add one more representative or replace your existing E.A.R. with Mars Medical.

[Business Meeting]

### Advanced

Your device is already placed on the market outside EU. Your device is ready for CE marking. Your
prospective distributors/ dealers will register your device with local competitive authority/
authorities.

[Brainstorming]

### Advanced Plus

Your device is under development and you are preparing for the launch. You need support in product
registration at local competent authority. You are also looking for assistance regarding clinical
investigations, incident notifications, assistance in implementing product recalls.

We have Special Fast Track Support for Manufacturers being affected by BREXIT

## About Us

Mars Medical, located in Europe’s #1 Innovative region and Mecca of Medical Device development, the
state of Baden-Württemberg, provides consultation as a European Authorised Representative for your
medical devices. We offer various levels of support for your device representation in EU region as a
E.A.R.
We have extensively worked in new device/ technology development in the area of gynecology, urology,
cardiology, neurology. We also worked in development of surgical instruments/ implants for Cosmetic
surgery, robotic surgery with a focus on Minimal Invasive interventions. This makes us unique as
your E.A.R. as we could able to provide excellent guidance for your products success in EEA region.

Home: Services

## Services


We offer E.A.R. services to suit your exact need. You can decide about the desired level of
representation that you require. Final agreement of role and responsibilities can be mutually
decided after thorough discussion about your device and your future plans.Contact us for further
details.With any of our existing E.A.R. services viz. Standard, Advanced or Advanced Plus, we offer
special offers for every additional products from the same family.We can also help you in setting up
QMS from our well established partners. Please write to
us your requirements by directly mailing us at [info@marsmedical.de][9] or by filling form through
Contact Us section.

Learn More
[Business Meeting]

### Standard

Your device is already CE marked. Your device is well registered with local competitive authority/
authorities and placed on the market in EU region. This means that you already have appointed E.A.R.
However, you want to add one more representative or replace your existing E.A.R. with Mars Medical.

[Business Meeting]

### Advanced

Your device is already placed on the market outside EU. Your device is ready for CE marking. Your
prospective distributors/ dealers will register your device with local competitive authority/
authorities.

[Brainstorming]

### Advanced Plus

Your device is under development and you are preparing for the launch. You need support in product
registration at local competent authority. You are also looking for assistance regarding clinical
investigations, incident notifications, assistance in implementing product recalls.

We have Special Fast Track Support for Manufacturers being affected by BREXIT

## The international distribution partner with added expertise in market access

MD Market Access partners with world-leading medical device manufacturers seeking rapid market entry
and sustainable international growth.

By working closely with our local team members and partners, we bridge the gap between innovation
and market adoption — ensuring clear communication, precise market alignment, and efficient,
scalable commercial execution across multiple regions.

MedTech veterans Regulatory compliance KOL & clinical access Long-term alignment
What we do

## Three commitments, one outcome

We work alongside your team as one integrated partnership — delivering fast revenue, strong field
execution and clinical intelligence that compounds, rather than a fragmented patchwork of services.

### Market Access

Country-specific product positioning, regulatory pathways, tender cycles and reimbursement — handled
in-country with your team.

### Field Execution

Local team and partners, technical training, surgeon proctoring and KOL relationships — built for
long-term commercial traction.

### Innovation Loop

Structured clinical feedback from every market flows back to your R&D — so your next-generation
product is shaped by real-world use.

Specialties

## Four high-acuity specialties World-leading innovation in each

We focus on differentiated, clinically meaningful devices in specialties where innovation makes the
biggest difference to patient outcomes — not commodity hardware.

01 [Cardiology]
Cardiology

Interventional cardiology, structural heart, electrophysiology and peripheral vascular devices.

Stents TAVR EP catheters Peripheral
02 [Neurology]
Neurology

Neurovascular intervention, neurostimulation, surgical navigation and neuromonitoring devices.

ThrombectomyDBSNavigationMonitoring
03 [Interventional Radiology]
Interventional Radiology

Image-guided catheter procedures, embolisation, vascular access, ablation and biopsy devices.

CathetersEmbolisationAblationBiopsy
04 [Urology]
Urology

Endourology and laser systems, BPH treatment, stone management, continence and reconstructive
devices.

LaserBPHStonesContinence

## The international distribution partner with added expertise in market access

and sustainable international growth.

MedTech veterans Regulatory compliance KOL & clinical access Long-term alignment
What we do

## Three commitments, one outcome

We work alongside your team as one integrated partnership — delivering fast revenue, strong field
execution and clinical intelligence that compounds, rather than a fragmented patchwork of services.

### Market Access

Country-specific product positioning, regulatory pathways, tender cycles and reimbursement — handled
in-country with your team.

### Field Execution

Local team and partners, technical training, surgeon proctoring and KOL relationships — built for
long-term commercial traction.

### Innovation Loop

Structured clinical feedback from every market flows back to your R&D — so your next-generation
product is shaped by real-world use.

### **Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC)**

Medical Device Regulation MDR (EU) 2017/745 and In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Device Regulation IVDR
(EU) 2017/746 state that every medical device manufacturer whose products are on the EU market is
required to have at its disposal a Person Responsible for the Regulatory Compliance (PRRC).

**We will be happy to act as your PRRC in the EU.**

[LEARN MORE][40]

### Regulations

REGULATION EC 2017/745 REGULATION EC 2017/746 REGULATION EC 1394/2007 US FDA 510(k) & PMA LATAM

### Regulation EC 2017/745

The European Union Medical Device Regulation EC 2017/745 (MDR) is the main medical devices
regulation (with the exception of in vitro diagnostic products) of the European Union. Regulation EC
2017/745 repeals the existing directives on medical devices: Medical Devices Directive 93/42/EEC
(general medical devices) and Directive 90/385/EEC (active implantable medical devices). The
regulation was published on 5 May 2017 and came into force on 25 May 2017. Originally approved
medical devices will have a transition time until 26 May 2021 to meet the new MDR requirements.

**MDRC helps medical devices manufacturers achieve MDR compliance and open your way to the EU
medical devices market.**

### Regulation EC 2017/746

The In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (IVDR) is the regulatory basis for placing on the
market, making available and putting into service in vitro diagnostic medical devices on the
European market. It will replace the EU’s current Directive on in vitro diagnostic medical devices
(Directive 98/79/EC). The Regulation was published in May 2017. Originally approved medical devices
will have a transition time until 26 May 2022 to meet the new IVDR requirements. As a European
regulation, Regulation EC 2017/746 will be effective in all EU member states and EFTA states
immediately without need to be transferred into the law of respective states, however national laws
may be adapted to back up some requirements in more detail.

**MDRC helps medical devices manufacturers achieve IVDR compliance and open your way to the EU
medical devices market.**

### Regulation EC 1394/2007

Regulation EC 1394/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council on advanced therapy medicinal
products amending Directive 2001/83/EC and Regulation EC 726/2004 is the basis of the regulatory
framework regulating gene, cell and tissue medicinal products on the European market. The Regulation
is directly applicable in the Member States of the European Union and requires no incorporation into
national law.

**MDRC helps manufacturers of gene, cell or tissue medicinal products achieve EC 1394/2007
compliance and open your way to the EU advanced therapy products market.**

### **510(k) EXEMPTION**

### **510(k)**

A 510(k) is a premarket submission made to FDA to demonstrate that the device to be marketed is as
safe and effective, that is, substantially equivalent, to a legally marketed device (section
513(i)(1)(A) FD&C Act). Submitters must compare their device to one or more similar legally marketed
devices and make and support their substantial equivalence claims.

### **PMA (21 CFR 814)**

Premarket approval (PMA) is the FDA process of scientific and regulatory review to evaluate the
safety and effectiveness of Class III medical devices. Class III devices are those that support or
sustain human life, are of substantial importance in preventing impairment of human health, or which
present a potential, unreasonable risk of illness or injury. PMA is the most stringent type of
device marketing application required by FDA. The applicant must receive FDA approval of its PMA
application prior to marketing the device. PMA approval is based on a determination by FDA that the
PMA contains sufficient valid scientific evidence to assure that the device is safe and effective
for its intended use.

**MDRC helps medical devices manufacturers achieve FDA compliance and open your way to the US
medical devices market.**

### ISO 13485

ISO 13485 Medical devices quality management systems is an International Organization for
Standardization (ISO) standard. It represents the requirements for a comprehensive quality
management system for the design and manufacture of medical devices. This standard supersedes
earlier documents such as EN 46001 (1993 and 1996) and EN 46002 (1996). There has been several
editions of ISO 13495. The current ISO 13485 edition was published on 1 March 2016. Compliance with
ISO 13485 is often seen as the first step in achieving compliance with European regulatory

European Union Regulations EC 2017/745 and EC 2017/746 must be assessed before sale is permitted.

sustain human life, are of substantial importance in preventing impairment of human health, or which
present a potential, unreasonable risk of illness or injury. PMA is the most stringent type of
device marketing application required by FDA. The applicant must receive FDA approval of its PMA
application prior to marketing the device. PMA approval is based on a determination by FDA that the
PMA contains sufficient valid scientific evidence to assure that the device is safe and effective
for its intended use.

**MDRC helps medical devices manufacturers achieve FDA compliance and open your way to the US
medical devices market.**

### ISO 13485

ISO 13485 Medical devices quality management systems is an International Organization for
Standardization (ISO) standard. It represents the requirements for a comprehensive quality
management system for the design and manufacture of medical devices. This standard supersedes
earlier documents such as EN 46001 (1993 and 1996) and EN 46002 (1996). There has been several
editions of ISO 13495. The current ISO 13485 edition was published on 1 March 2016. Compliance with
ISO 13485 is often seen as the first step in achieving compliance with European regulatory

## Intra Corporeal Pneumatic Lithotripter

Intra Corporeal Pneumatic Lithotripter, simply known as Lithotripsy, is a proven and effective
treatment procedure for stones in the kidneys, bladder and ureter. The non-invasive surgical
procedure is performed using a lithotripter that sends high Pneumatic energy to fragment the stones
into fine particles which are eliminated through the urinary tract.

Nidhi Meditech Systems is one of the leading Intra corporeal pneumatic **lithotripter 
****manufacturers** in the world, bringing the innovativeness and precision-engineering of
“NIDHILITH Digi.” It is a unique device designed for intra-corporeal stone fragmentation through the
process of “Direct Contact Lithotripsy.”

The Intra corporeal pneumatic lithotripter is regarded safe, effective and inexpensive in
pulverizing the stones, especially the bigger ones, eliminating the need for a major surgery
procedure. The meticulously-designed rigid probe aids in fast and safe defragmentation of the hard
and large stones located in the urinary system. This eliminates the probability of heat generation
at the tip of the probe, thus, preventing consequent damages to the mucosa.

# Committed to driving progress

in uro-oncology precision diagnostics

At Photocure, we have long been operating in bladder cancer diagnostics, where precision matters, as
we focus all our efforts and resources on delivering meaningful advances for patients with
urological cancers.

Learn More
[Healthcare professional talking to patient]

### **Improving the lives of bladder cancer patients**

There is a growing trend toward precision medicine and precision diagnostics in uro-oncology. Find
our expertise in bladder cancer diagnostics focused in this array of transformative solutions,
aiming to provide physicians with the right information at the right time, to inform more
personalized decisions on how best to manage each individual patient.

Our products
[Healthcare professionals in meeting]

Photocure shareholders enjoy the benefits of our strong, global company vision, expertise and
transparent approach to business. If you’re new to our business, this [FAQ][2] can be of use.

[Office lobby]

### **Photocure’s Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Progress Report**

As well as our commitment to medicine, Photocure has a strong dedication to progressing our
contribution to ESG.

> **“At Photocure, we have long been operating in bladder cancer diagnostics, where precision
> matters, as we focus all our efforts and resources on delivering meaningful advances for patients
>  with urological cancers.”**

###### Dan Schneider, President and CEO of Photocure

Read our latest ESG report
[Beyond the buzzwords: How AI and advancing diagnostic technologies will transform early bladder
cancer care]

Stay up to date with our opinion on the latest topics in the urologic oncology healthcare space.

At Photocure, we are always excited about new ideas and have a proven track record of finding,
developing and bringing new technologies to market through effective collaboration.

## Endoscope Repair

Extend the lifespan of your high-cost endoscopy equipment with our **industry-leading endoscope
repair services**. Our expert technicians repair scopes from most major manufacturers, including
Olympus, Pentax, Storz, Fujinon, and Stryker, using **OEM-equivalent parts** to ensure like-new
performance.
* **Fast, Reliable Repairs:** Minimize downtime with our efficient repair process.
* **Free Loaner Scopes:** Stay operational while your scope is under repair.
* **Comprehensive Warranty:** All repairs are backed by a robust warranty for peace of mind.

[ Learn More ][140]

## Pre-Owned & Refurbished endoscopes for sale

Upgrade your facility’s equipment with **refurbished, pre-owned endoscopes** from Pro Scope Systems.
Our extensive inventory includes flexible and rigid scopes meticulously inspected and restored to
meet or exceed OEM standards.
* **Cost Savings:** Save thousands compared to new equipment.
* **Top Manufacturers:** Olympus, Pentax, Storz, Fujinon, and Stryker.
* **Like-New Quality:** Every scope undergoes a 50-point inspection and rigorous testing.
* **Comprehensive Warranty:** Confidence in your purchase backed by one of the best warranties in
  the industry.

# www.urology-textbook.com:
# Free and Up-To-Date

These pages offer free, up-to-date information on all major areas of urology. While the English
translation from the original German version is still in progress, detailed descriptions of the most
important urological diseases are already available. The goal: clear, structured knowledge for
clinical practice and medical education.

This website is designed for physicians and medical professionals. It presents diseases of the
genital organs through detailed text and images. Some content may not be suitable for children or
sensitive readers. Many illustrations are available exclusively to Steady members. Are you a
physician and interested in supporting this project? [Join Steady to unlock full access][21] to all
images and enjoy an ad-free experience. Try it free for 7 days—no obligation.

**New release:** The first edition of the Urology Textbook as an e-book—ideal for offline reading
and quick reference. With over 1300 pages and hundreds of illustrations, it’s the perfect companion
for residents and medical students. After your 7-day trial has ended, you will receive a download
link for your exclusive e-book.

The [index][22] provides an alphabetical list of diseases, procedures, and relevant keywords. All
chapters are free and accessible. Many new sections and images will be published shortly; please
refer to my Steady page [https://steady.page/de/urology/posts][23] for more information.

## About the Author

[Dirk Manski, Author of Urology-Textbook.com]

Dr. Dirk Manski studied medicine at the Free University of Berlin. He received his doctorate in 2002
at the University of Erlangen with a thesis on collagen VI signal transduction in mesenchymal cells,
supervised by Prof. Dr. Dr. Schuppan. He completed his urology residency at the Charité Berlin and
Klinikum Kempten in Bavaria.

From 2006 to 2014, Dr. Manski served as an attending urologist at the University Hospital Augsburg.
Since 2015, he has been working as a [urologist in private practice][24] and as an attending
physician at the Stadtklinik Diako in Augsburg.

His clinical focus includes endourology, urooncology, laparoscopy and reconstructive surgery.

Dr. Manski is the author and editor of www.urology-textbook.com, which he has been developing and
managing since 2014 to provide high-quality, evidence-based urological education. [PDF
Abstract][25].

## What is Urology?

Urology is a surgical and medical specialty that deals with the basics, diagnosis, and treatment of
urinary tract and sexual organs diseases. The urologist thus treats diseases of the [kidneys][26],
[ureters][27], [bladder][28], [urethra][29], [testes][30], [prostate][31], [penis][32], and [adrenal
glands][33]. Each organ can be affected by congenital diseases, infections, trauma, benign diseases,
or malignant tumors.

# www.urology-textbook.com:
# Free and Up-To-Date

These pages offer free, up-to-date information on all major areas of urology. While the English
translation from the original German version is still in progress, detailed descriptions of the most
important urological diseases are already available. The goal: clear, structured knowledge for
clinical practice and medical education.

This website is designed for physicians and medical professionals. It presents diseases of the
genital organs through detailed text and images. Some content may not be suitable for children or
sensitive readers. Many illustrations are available exclusively to Steady members. Are you a
physician and interested in supporting this project? [Join Steady to unlock full access][21] to all
images and enjoy an ad-free experience. Try it free for 7 days—no obligation.

**New release:** The first edition of the Urology Textbook as an e-book—ideal for offline reading
and quick reference. With over 1300 pages and hundreds of illustrations, it’s the perfect companion
for residents and medical students. After your 7-day trial has ended, you will receive a download
link for your exclusive e-book.

The [index][22] provides an alphabetical list of diseases, procedures, and relevant keywords. All
chapters are free and accessible. Many new sections and images will be published shortly; please
refer to my Steady page [https://steady.page/de/urology/posts][23] for more information.

## About the Author

[Dirk Manski, Author of Urology-Textbook.com]

Dr. Dirk Manski studied medicine at the Free University of Berlin. He received his doctorate in 2002
at the University of Erlangen with a thesis on collagen VI signal transduction in mesenchymal cells,
supervised by Prof. Dr. Dr. Schuppan. He completed his urology residency at the Charité Berlin and
Klinikum Kempten in Bavaria.

From 2006 to 2014, Dr. Manski served as an attending urologist at the University Hospital Augsburg.
Since 2015, he has been working as a [urologist in private practice][24] and as an attending
physician at the Stadtklinik Diako in Augsburg.

His clinical focus includes endourology, urooncology, laparoscopy and reconstructive surgery.

Dr. Manski is the author and editor of www.urology-textbook.com, which he has been developing and
managing since 2014 to provide high-quality, evidence-based urological education. [PDF
Abstract][25].

## What is Urology?

Urology is a surgical and medical specialty that deals with the basics, diagnosis, and treatment of
urinary tract and sexual organs diseases. The urologist thus treats diseases of the [kidneys][26],
[ureters][27], [bladder][28], [urethra][29], [testes][30], [prostate][31], [penis][32], and [adrenal
glands][33]. Each organ can be affected by congenital diseases, infections, trauma, benign diseases,
or malignant tumors.
